headline: Ramayana is expected to reach about 1.25M tickets today (968K–1.49M); Jailer 2 is tracking 19% lower than yesterday.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana is expected to sell about 58K tickets in the 11 AM–12 PM hour (range 43K–64.9K), rising to about 63.1K by 1–2 PM.
Its busiest hour still ahead is 8–9 PM, at an estimated 81.1K (range 48.6K–117K), and today could total about 1.25M, 20% above yesterday.

Tomorrow, Saturday, is forecast at about 1.82M (range 1.27M–2.49M). As an opening-day film, Ramayana is forecast from earlier films' release-day and day-two patterns, so the range is wide; BookMyShow rating (+6%) and critics (+3%) lean the forecast up.

Jailer 2 is expected at about 1.1K per hour through early afternoon, with its peak around 8–9 PM at about 1.7K (range 1K–2.4K). No review or word-of-mouth signals are switched on for it, so its outlook rests on the hourly pattern alone.
watch: Mixed word of mouth and several Tamil releases this week (Scene, Mookuthi Amman 2, Moonwalk) could pull Ramayana toward the lower end of its range.
Diwali falls on 2026-11-08, and holiday demand could move both films' weekend numbers in either direction.
